youtube_description: In this video, you are guided through an experiment to determine the osmolarity of plant (potato) cells.  We incubate potato cores in solutions of varying sucrose concentrations and track the changes in the weight of the potato cores.
youtube_title: Determining Potato Osmolarity (BIOL101 - Diffusion & Osmosis Lab)
